- Model consistently overestimates prices, especially in early days of the forecast horizon; reduce initial forecast values by 1–3% for better alignment.
- After sharp price spikes, model tends to overshoot and fail to correct — dampen forecast peaks by 5–10% in subsequent periods.
- Model exhibits mean reversion bias: over-predicts after strong upward moves, under-predicts after strong downward moves — adjust forecasts toward historical 30-day moving average.
- Forecast lag: model often lags true price movements by 1–3 days; shift forecast values forward by 1–2 days for better timing.
- In high volatility periods (e.g., 2025-08-18), model overreacts to short-term noise — apply smoothing filter or reduce volatility sensitivity in forecast algorithm.
